title: Billing cycle
description: Read the meters, review the drafts, issue the month's invoices.
noCycleBody: Open this month's cycle to compute the drafts from the leases and the meter readings.
autoIssueBody: Ready drafts are issued at {at} unless you issue them before.
pendingHint: Before the cut-off {cutoff}. Staff read them in the reading round.
noPending: Every meter has its reading for this cycle.
draftsHint: Open a draft to check its lines, readings and photos. Flags show what the platform wants you to look at.
issuedTitle: {count, plural, one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}

actions.issueBody: {property}, {period}: {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} totalling {total}. Ready drafts are sent to the residents; drafts still waiting for a reading stay as drafts.
actions.issueConfirm: Issue {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
actions.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {# draft was not issued} other {# drafts were not issued}}
actions.closeBody: {property}, {period}. Nothing more can be issued in this cycle.

review.caption: Draft invoices of the cycle
review.failed: The lines could not be loaded.

charge.title: One-off charge — unit {unit}
